title: Investigate whether overturning follows native rows or true latitude
status: PROVISIONAL — do not submit as a confirmed erratum
proposed_severity: Potentially High for geometry; Medium for grid metadata
description: On a tripolar ocean mesh, a grid row can bend away from a geographic parallel. Summing transports along that row and labelling it as a true-latitude overturning section may describe the wrong geometry. The current reduced output also keeps the source grid label.
example: An Arctic row can wander across latitudes. A transport assigned to a single latitude may then not be the transport across that parallel, even if the sum itself was computed correctly.
scientific_evidence: The 28 msftm/msfty datasets retain g116 on reduced basin/latitude output. #827 identifies an unresolved distinction between summing native tripolar j rows and integrating geographic parallels. This audit confirms the reduced dimensions and labels; it does not independently resolve the Arctic transport geometry or validate basin masks.
impact: The 28 msftm/msfty datasets retain g116 on reduced basin/latitude output. #827 identifies an unresolved distinction between summing native tripolar j rows and integrating geographic parallels. This audit confirms the reduced dimensions and labels; it does not independently resolve the Arctic transport geometry or validate basin masks.
recommended_action: Trace the native transport paths and compare msftm with msfty before choosing a replacement grid or changing coordinates. Do not relabel native rows as true latitude merely to make metadata pass.
development_team_action: MOPPy and MOM/ocean diagnostic developers: establish the native integration paths, basin masks and intended msftm versus msfty meaning before relabelling or changing calculations. #827/#830 already document the scientific blocker. Avoid a cosmetic grid-label fix that claims an unverified topology.
extent_statement: Investigation scope only; files are not established to be defective.
publication_action: No withdrawal, retraction, replacement or ESGF submission performed by this task.
